newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador to announce economic program mid-November.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador to announce economic program mid-November.

text.p: The Ecuadorean government will announce its new economic program in mid-November, President Abdala Bucaram said Friday.
"It is very possible that we will give this out November 13 or 14, after my visit to the Ibero-American summit," Bucaram told reporters.
The government says the program will outline its economic policies over its four-year term.
